scope: Bounded source inspection; not exhaustive inventory

Tree has download scripts and model embeddings but no .fil/.h5 observational matrices. No source powers acquired.

No observational .fil/.h5 arrays in repository tree. Author documentation says HDF5 event databases are table columns of frequencies/rates/SNR/categories, paired with images; they are not original power matrices.

Deposited sband2019.tar.gz is derived turboSETI .dat output; static.tar.gz contains event tables and images according to linked author repository. Original filterbank powers are on Berkeley archive. Neither archive downloaded.

Author-deposited 3.9 GB LOFAR spectrogram anomaly dataset found. Narrowband SETI ON/OFF suitability not established; no payload acquired or claimed. Page open timed out; metadata corroborated by authoritative search.

transport_notes: GitHub fetch_blob decoded binary as UTF-8 and failed; ordinary raw.githubusercontent.com retrieval succeeded with HTTP 200. This is the author's repository object, not a proxy for a blocked archive.
An initial binary retrieval checked 38176-byte response without preserving it; a subsequent ordinary request saved and git-hash-verified identical object bytes.
